rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (23 tracks) per https://www.theingroove.com/products/radiohead-ok-computer-oknotok-1997-2017-lp, https://punktofunkheaven.co.uk/products/radiohead-ok-computer-oknotok-1997-2017-label-xl-recordings-xllp868-format-3-x-vinyl-lp-album. Official 20th-anniversary reissue (Jun 2017, XL Recordings), 3xLP. Tracks 1-12 = remastered OK Computer; tracks 13-23 = 8 B-sides plus 3 previously unreleased tracks (I Promise, Man of War, Lift). 'Pearly*' carries its official asterisk.
